claim: Held-out results on prompts each frozen revision had never seen: revision 5 81.5% exact (6.0% under-routed) on fresh set 1; revision 6 78.5% (9.0% under, 12.5% over) on fresh set 2; revision 7 80.0% (10.5% under, 9.5% over) on fresh set 3, where revisions 5 and 6 scored 71.5% and 74.0%. Each revision improves the same unseen prompts, but held-out accuracy stays near 78-82% with 6-10% under-routing. Development-set scores are fitted. The owner's 95% goal is about real chat threads staying on the chosen model; it is not measured by these synthetic sets and is not claimed.

fresh_sets.method: Each revision was frozen (committed) before a new 200-prompt set, written by two independent agents blind to the classifier and to every earlier set, was scored once. A separate agent re-labelled each set from the prompts alone. Every set was then used as development data for the next revision.
